notes: Final review of PR #632 @ eac057a8 (test-only: packages/core/test/kindSchemasFeatureChoices.test.ts, +158). Checked against optFeatureChoiceArray / optBoolTrue in packages/core/src/rules/kindSchemas.ts:624-705 and bead eshyra-v0db AC (missing sibling, optionId not in sibling from, optional:false). All three AC cases covered, plus self-reference, sibling without from, non-object requiresOption, missing optionId, optional:'true', and a positive control. Ran the file: 9/9 pass; biome check clean. Mutation reasoning: removing the 'sibling === entry' guard makes the self-reference test fail (optionId 'common' is deliberately in the dependent's own from); removing the Array.isArray(sibling.from) guard turns the no-from case into a TypeError that fails the message regex; relaxing optBoolTrue to optBool fails the optional:false test; the positive control proves the hand-built base record is otherwise valid, so each rejection is attributable to the targeted field. Permanent-evidence: protects a durable pack-validator contract that the real pack and importer guard tests do not exercise negatively; not a duplicate. S1 (NON-MATERIAL, kindSchemasFeatureChoices.test.ts:70): self-reference regex omits the choices[1].requiresOption.choiceId 'race-language' prefix, so it localizes less tightly than its siblings; optional tightening. S2 (NON-MATERIAL): no case for a sibling whose from is a string/structured object (also rejected by the same Array.isArray branch); optional. VERDICT: NO MATERIAL FINDINGS
